title: Alpha Flight #51 Marvel Comics 1987 1st Jim Lee Marvel Interior Art
descriptionText:
Alpha Flight #51 (October 1987, Marvel Comics) -- Jim Lee's first full interior artwork for Marvel Comics, in a story written by Bill Mantlo. A genuine key issue for Jim Lee / X-Men-era collectors. Cover price 75c US.

Condition: Very Good. Please review all photos as they're of the actual copy you'll receive.
